_comment: Recorded Graph API responses, so the whole client can be exercised offline: the limit
checks, the idempotency, the pagination, the parsing and the dry run. Keys are
'<METHOD> <path>'; a key with several entries replays them in order, and the last one
repeats so a caller that polls does not exhaust it.
Every group id, phone number, subject and invite link below is invented. The group ids
follow WhatsApp's '<digits>@g.us' shape so the parsing is exercised on something
realistic, and the phone numbers are in a range reserved for examples.
The create response is deliberately absent: Meta documents no response body for that
endpoint, and the demo's create is withheld by the dry run anyway.

GET 120363000000000001@g.us.subject: Example Ltd — matter 4470
GET 120363000000000001@g.us.description: Standing notice: this group is for matter 4470 only. Anything else goes to the office address.
